newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures close lower on thin markets.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures close lower on thin markets.

text.p: LIFFE wheat and barley futures closed lower on Tuesday on thinly traded markets.
Wheat futures closed 0.60 to 0.10 stg down after trading 176 lots.
Most active March had a last trade of 94.50 stg, 0.60 stg down on a turnover of 56 lots.
Barley futures finished 0.75 to 0.50 stg down on with a total volume of 64 lots.
January finished with a last trade of 90.75 stg, 0.75 down after trading 32 lots while March last traded at 92.75 stg, 0.50 stg lower after also trading 32 lots.
